tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// lha mo 'od zer can ma'i man ngag mdor bsdus pa'i yi ge 'jigs pa'i mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na ma āryā mā rī tsyai/ sku yi nyin byed snying dbus su// 'char ba'i mod la 'jigs pa'i mun// skrod pa'i 'phags ma la btud nas// de yi bsnyen sgrub las gsum spel// de la 'dir 'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i nyer mkho'i man ngag cung zad 'chad pa la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshul la sbyor la dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rdor phreng nas byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas gza' tshes dge bar gnas dben par byi dor byas la/ 'byor na rje btsun ma'i sku rten bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/ yi dam 'od zer can ma la cog zlum gcig dang*/ rang gi rgyun gtor gang byed/ cha gsum gtor ma gtong ba grub na'ang de'i gtor ma dang*/ gzhan nyer spyod bsham pa sogs spyi ltar shes par bya'o// de nas yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sogs par cha gsum gtor ma yid ches pa gtang*/ gnas khang gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs nas gtsang spra dang ldan pas bsam gtan gyi 'bol chung bde bar rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'dug ste dad pa dang nges 'byung dang snying rje shugs drag tu bskyed nas/ gnas skabs dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thugs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir 'di bsgrub par bya'o snyam du thun la 'jug de'ang kha lta phyogs snga dro shar dang*/ dgong mo nub tu bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ tshogs bsag pa'o// dang po skyabs 'gro la/ rgyu yul tshul sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya ba las 'dir 'bri mi dgos mod/

de'i nang nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gsal 'debs pa'i tshul cung zad smos na/ rang nyid gnas pa'i zhing 'di ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i sa gzhi bai ḍūrya'i rang bzhin can gyi dbus su/ rang gi mdun gyi bar snang la phag bdun gyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i rnam pa la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba'am/ yang na mdun gyi sa gzhi las yar skyes pa'i tshul gyis dpag bsam shing gi yal ga lo ma 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rtse mor padma 'dab ma bzhi pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba thams cad kyang 'od zer can ma'i rnam pa can dang mdun gyi 'dab mar 'od zer can ma sogs yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ g.yas kyi 'dab mar longs sprul gyis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyab kyi 'dab mar lung rtogs kyi chos kyi ngo bo glegs bam brtsegs pa/ g.yon gyi 'dab mar byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang nyan thos dgra bcom gyi tshogs/ gzhan yang chos srung nor lha rnams kyang mtha' skor dpag bsam shing gi lo 'dab kun tu bzhugs par gsal gdab/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das= dam pa'i chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun nams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes brgya'am nyer gcig sogs dmigs pa dang ma bral bar ci nus bzla zhing*/ mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams mtha' nas rim gyis 'dus te gtso bo dang*/ de nyid 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim pa sogs spyi ltar ro// gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/

bdag gis sems can sogs dkyus kyi tshig de nyid ngag du brjod cing sems can gyi don du rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ni smon pa'i sems dang*/ de'i ched du 'od zer can ma'i sgom bzlas la 'bad pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed pa yin no// gsum la tshogs bsag pa la gnyis/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs so// dang po ni/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa de la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ de dag gi spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba rnams kyi ngag 'don no// rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs pa'i mam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bodhi satwo bhyaḥ oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi satwā ya arghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar 'gre/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi dmigs rnam dang 'brel bar sems can thams cad sogs/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyi sngags brjod pas/ rang gi phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gtan la phab nas de'ang nam mkha' la sprin yal ba ltar mi dmigs par bsam pa nyid do// de rnams ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ lha bskyed pa dang*/ bzlas pa bya ba'o/

bsnyen sgrub las gsum gang gi'ang mgor/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya'am don kun 'grub pa'i phyag bcing bar gsungs pa ni/ lag gnyis thal mo kha sbyar ba phye/ mthe chen cung zad bkug gung mo gnyis rtse gtugs/ mdzub mos gung mo la sbyar ba zlum pa'i rnam par byas pa'o// 'dir lte ba'i thad du bzhag par gsung gi gzhan du ji skad bshad pa'i gnas su'o// mchan/ dang po ni/ sngar gyi stong nyid de'i ngang las rang sems gsal ba'i gdangs 'gag med yi ge bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten chen po'i bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa mām̐ las mya ngan med pa'i shing mām̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ shin tu mdzes pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'o// zhes zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gsal gdab pa ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag go

/de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying gi nang du mām̐ ser po zhes gnas gsum du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo 'bru gsum bsgom pa ni byin gyis rlob pa nyer sgrub kyi yan lag go /de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi satwā ya arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ nas shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mā rī tsāai sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes snying ga'i mām̐ gyi 'od zer gyis rje btsun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar spyan drangs nas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbyer med du bya ba dang bcas pa ni sgrub pa'i yan lag go /slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags sbyar ba gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ zhes dbang lha rigs lnga rnam snang gtso bor byas pa spyan drangs/ de la gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rigs bdag rnam par snang mdzad sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs nas/ de la rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa rnams kyis tshur rang la mchod pa'i bsam pas/ oṃ āryā mā rī tsyai arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/

gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa kun las myur du skyob mdzad cing*// dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad ma// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa dang bcas pa ni lha bskyed cing mchod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ thog mar lha sku rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag sngags bzla ba na/ rang gi thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la mam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'char kha'i mdangs ltar 'phros/ rang gi lus thams cad du khyab pas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas gzhan nor rku 'phrog byas pa sogs sdig sgrib gang bsags bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang 'od zer ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams zhing*/ oṃ mā rī tsyai mām̐ swā hā/ zhes yang snying ci nus pa bzla'o// grangs kyis bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bdun cu ste/ de snyed bzlas na las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do// thun mjug tu/ tadya thā/ oṃ pa tā kra ma si la sogs pa rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ ba tā li la sogs pa snying po'i sngags dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ ā lo tā lo la sogs pa'i las kyi sngags rnams gang mos pa la ci nus bzla bar bya'o// thun las ldang bar 'dod na/ rang la bstims pa'i ye shes pa phyung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs pa la mchod pas mchod nas bzod par gsol te/ oṃ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol la/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams kyi bya ba gzungs mdo klog pa sogs la 'jug par bya ste/ de ni skabs 'dir 'phags pa'i gsung rab ltar klog cing*/ gzhan du klog thabs gzhan ltar gdon par bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/

dkar gtor bshams pa sbyangs la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bhrūm̐ las grub pa'i sogs nas/ dbur brgyan pa'i bar gong ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'am/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa'i 'od zer can ma badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ oṃ mā rī tsyai de wī sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ mā rī tsyai i daṃ pa liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod la/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa kun las myur du skyob mdzad cing*// dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa dgra dang bgegs thams cad las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jigs pa thams cad las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes brjod pas bdag la 'dod pa'i don thams cad gnang nas gshegs par bsam mo// de ltar thun bzhi'am gsum gang byed kyi tshul rnams bsnyen thabs spyi 'gros ltar shes par byas la/ bzlas pa'i grangs kha skong dang bcas pa thems pa na kha skong gi sbyin sreg gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar gyis rig sngags kyi nus stobs rgyas par byas te/ mchod gtor gtang rag gis mtha' brgyan cing*/ grol tshes yar ngor grol nas chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma zlum po bshams pa'i rtse mor lha mo'i tsakli btsugs pa lha mo'i bris sku'i mdun du bsham/

sa'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi nang ya gab ma gab la mam̐ yig re bris pa'i mig tu sngags ring bris/ mig gi gong du dgra jag chom rkun gyi ming bris pa'i bar du go gsum thal bas bkang la kha sbyar/ steng du rdo rje rgya gram bri/ skud pa ser pos rgya gram du bcings la gtor ma'i 'og tu bzhag shing gi dbyug pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i mgo dang*/ yu ba rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can zhig bsham/ gzhan mchod gtor sogs gong bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin tshogs par byas te/ dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni skyabs 'gro nas bzung*/ bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin nar 'ded du btang nas bsnyen pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad tsam song mtshams/ sgrub pa'i bzlas dmigs khyad par ba ni/ rang dang gdan gyi phag las gser gyi mdog can gyi phag grangs med pa ngur sgra sgrogs bzhin spros te kha phyir bstan pa'i rwa ba rim pa gsum du bskor zhing dpangs mtho ba'i steng 'og tu a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kha leb dang zhabs sdom sprad pa lta bu de'i yang steng 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re ste nyi zla sum sbrags kyi nang khongs dbus su rang nyid/ steng du chos dang bla ma/ mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su spun sring zhang po/ rgyab tu bran dang nor/ g.yon du bu chung ma sogs bsrung bya gang yod thams cad chud pa la/ nyi zla'i 'od zer bltar mi bzod par 'bar bas dgra cag chom rkun gcan gzan la sogs pa glags lta ba'i gnod par sems pa rnams kyi mig bsregs te phyogs tsam yang mthong ma nus par bsgribs par bsams pa'i dmigs pa rtse gcig pas/ tadya thā/ oṃ battā li/ ba dā li/ ba rā li/ bā rā ha mu khi/ sarba duṣṭhā/ pra duṣṭhā naṃ/ tsakṣurmu khaṃ bhandha bhandha/ bandha mu khaṃ/ dzaṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya swā hā/ oṃ lha mo 'od zer can bdag cag dpon slob mi nor thams cad la skyobs shig swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing*/

thun bsdu ba na gong bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar ye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa sogs 'dra/ de nas mdun rten rnams/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che sogs nas/ rnam par snang mdzad sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis rgyas 'debs pa'i bar gyis bskyed nas/ mchod pa spyi ltar byin brlabs te/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// lha mo 'od zer can mar 'bul// bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// oṃ ārya mā rī tsyai sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil/ pā dyaṃ/ me tog puṣpe/ bdug spos/ dhū pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke/ dri mchog gandhe/ zhal zas/ nai wi dya/ rol mo/ shabda rnams sbyar bas mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs rol chen bya/ bstod pa ni/ gang gi mtshan tsam sogs nas/ srid zhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung las byung bas bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs 'bul ba/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar la/ gtor mgron spyan drang ba mi dgos/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas dmigs ni/ mdun gyi lha mo dang gdan las phag gi tshogs spro ba sogs gong dang 'dra bas bzlas pa bya/ mthar 'dod don gsol gdab/ rten la brtan bzhugs/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge bsngo byas te thun mtshams la 'jug thun gzhan la'ang des rigs 'gre/ de ltar sgrub pa'i tshe rmi lam du sbrul spre'u byi la bong bu rta glang ma he dred khyi la sogs pa 'thabs shing 'dzings pa dang*/ rang nyid skrag sngangs snying mi dga' ba sogs byung na bar chad kyi rtags yin pas rang bzhin med pa'i lta bas zin par byas te sngags nyis 'gyur la sogs pa bzla/ rgya mtsho las brgal ba/ ri bo la 'dzeg cing gnas pa/

sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ khyad par du 'od zer can ma nyid mjal zhing lung ston pa/ gzhon nu ma rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa dang 'phrad pa rmi ba dang*/ dngos su dri bzangs 'thul ba dang*/ mar me 'dzin pa sogs byung na 'grub pa'i rtags te ci rigs pa dngos nyams rmi lam du ma byung bar sgrub pa ni mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'o// zla ba drug gam gsum du sgrub pa dus kyi bsnyen pa/ 'bum phrag drug tu bzla ba grangs kyi bsnyen pa ste rab 'bring tha ma'i sgrub ba'o// de lta bu'i sgo nas rab 'bring tha ma'i tshad dang grangs thems pa na gwa'u mis mi mthong bar dben par 'jog gtang rag gi mchod gtor rgya cher bya'o/ gsum pa las sbyor ni/ gsham bkod sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin dang*/ ngag 'don kyang skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste sgrub pa'i sngags cung zad re bzlas ba'i bar gong bzhin la/ las sbyor gyi dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ rang nyid 'od zer can mar gsal ba'i sku las sprul pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas byon pa'i lha mo'i tshogs gser mdog dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ phyag na khab skud bsnams pas gnod byed rnams kyi kha mig 'tshems pa/ phag ser po rlung gi shugs can la chibs pa 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa khyab par spros pas dgra jag chom rkun la sogs pa phyi rol gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog cing bskrad par bsams la/ oṃ mā rī tsyai mām̐ swā hā/ oṃ ba rā li/ ba dā li/ batta li/ bā rā ha mu khi/ sarba duṣṭhā naṃ/ pra duṣṭhā nāṃ/ gnod byed dgra jag chom rkun thams cad tsakṣurmu khaṃ bandha bandha swā hā/ zhes pa 'di nyid grangs kyi gtso bor bzung ste bzla/ thun bsdu ldang dang*/ mdun bskyed la gtor ma 'bul tshul/ sgrub pa'i rtags tshad rnams kyang gong ltar ro// mthar gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ yig brgya mang du bzlas la nongs pa bshags/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ mdun gyi lha rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/

med na gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de ltar bsnyen sgrub las gsum thems pas las sgrub pa ni/ lam du 'gro bar byed pa na/ gang 'gro phyogs su bltas la rang gi spyi bor byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bcings la snying po lan gsum brjod do// de nas chos gos la sogs pa'i grwa la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ser po la mam̐ ser po bsams te/ gdug pa can rnams mam̐ gyi 'od kyis bkug la mam̐ la gzhug go /dbugs ma shor bar mdud pa gsum bya'o// yang na skud pa byas la gos kyi mtha' ma'am ska rags la gdags so// zla ba gcig tu mdud par bsam mo// 'grol ba la ni nyin mtshan de nyid du dgrol bar bya'o// yang shing bu sor bzhi pa gnyis rna ltag g.yas g.yon du bcug la glang po che'i mche bar bsam ste 'jigs pa bsrung ngo*// zhes 'byung ba ltar rang nyid lha mor bsgom/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya spyi bor bcings te snying po bzla bzhin du sngar bsgrubs pa'i dbyug pa bzung ste 'gro ba dang*/ shing bu rna ltag la bcug ste song na 'jigs pa bsrung bar 'gyur la/ srung skud byed na/ skud pa dkar po la rdo rje'i mdud pa nyer gcig re btab/ mdud pa re re bzhin dbugs thogs gcig la sngags ring yid bzlas tshar re byas te gdab/ lha mor bskyed cing slar yang sngags ci nus bzlas la rang sngags rten rnying gis rab gnas byas te gang bsrung ba'i mgul du btags pas chom rkun la sogs pa srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur bas na gzhan la phan 'dod rnams kyis bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o// de dag ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum rim can du nyams su len tshul rgyas pa'i lugs dang*/ 'bring po stabs gcig tu nyams su len par 'dod na mkhas grub karma chags med kyi yig cha ltar shes par bya la/ de las kyang bsdus pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa ni/ a/ gser mdog phag gi rwa ba gsum rim nang*// nyi zla gwa'u rim pa gsum gyi dbus// rang nyid mām̐ las 'od zer can ma ser// zhi 'dzum khab skud 'dzin cing phyed skyil bzhugs// stod g.yogs aṃ rag sngon po sham thabs dkar// sna tshogs rgyan ldan rnam snang dbu rgyan can// thugs kar zla steng sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor// 'od kyis rang 'dra dpag med spyan drangs thim// lha mo phag zhon grangs med 'jig rten gang*// gnod byed dgra bgegs kha mig btsems par gyur// de ltar mngon rtogs dran rdzogs gsal btab nas// bsnyen pa srung ba las sbyor rnam pa gsum// dmigs pa so sor rtse gcig bsgom zhing bzlas// dang po rang nyid lha mo'i skur gsal ba'i// thugs dbus zla steng mam̐ yig 'grengs te gnas// de mthar snying po 'bru drug sngags de ni// mdun nas brtsams te yig mgo nang du bstan// g.yas su bskor nas 'khod pa gsal btab ste// de nyid klog pa'i tshul du cung zad bzlas// de nas sngags phreng de nyid mi 'khor bar// phreng ba'i phreng lung bzhin du 'od ser po// g.yon du 'khor bar dmigs la bzlas pa bya// de ni 'di yi lugs kyi bsnyen pa yin// de nas sngags 'phreng dang po dal bu'i 'khor// de nas je mgyogs shin tu mgyogs par 'khor// de nas 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros// sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib 'jigs skrag bsal// 'od des sangs rgyas kun mchod thugs rgyud bskul// sangs rgyas thams cad 'od zer can ma'i skur// gyur nas kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin byon// khyad par o rgyan yul dang rgya gar na// mya ngan med pa'i shing gi sdong po nas// 'od zer can ma dpag tu med pa byon// bdag la thim pas mthu stobs byin rlabs thob// oṃ mā rī tsyai swā hā/

de ltar bzla ba 'di yi sgrub pa yin// 'di yi sgrub pa rtse gcig byed na ni// dus bsnyen zla ba gcig gam nyer gcig bya// grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag drug yin no// bzhi 'gyur bzlas na nges par 'grub par 'gyur// rtags ni chu bo che las brgal ba dang*// ri brag btsan zhing che ba'i sar 'dug dang*// bud med gzhon nu mdzes mar 'phrad pa dang*// lha mo nyid dam sangs rgyas byang sems mjal// de dag nyams dang rmi lam skabs su 'byung*// dngos su dri zhim sna tshogs bro ba dang*// mar me 'dzin nam me lce sngar las ring*// de dag 'grub pa'i rtags ni yin par gsungs// gal te sbrul dang spre'u byi la dang*// bong bu rta dang glang po ma he dang*// dred dang khyi sogs phan tshun 'thabs pa dang*// gzhan yang rang nyid 'jigs skrag byung rmis na// da dung sngags ni nyis 'gyur bzla dgos gsungs// 'di yi thun mtshams dkar gsum gtor ma bsham// a kā ro yi sngags kyis byin rlabs pa// rtsa sngags ba liṃ kha hi btags pas 'bul// yid kyis lha mo spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs// ljags kyi 'od zer sbu gu gtor mar zug /bdud rtsi drangs shing gsol bas mnyes par bsgom// spro na rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs kyis mchod/ med na arghaṃ la sogs sngags mchod chog spro na spyi bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung bya// gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// bar du gcod pa kun las srung mdzad cing*// dri med bde ba chen po stsol mdzad ma// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtor mgron rten la thim mam gshegs par dmigs// de ltar bsnyen pa thems nas srung ba ni// phag rgod ser po 'jigs shing ya nga ba// kha gdangs mche gtsigs ze ba gyen du langs// kha phyir bltas shing ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs// de 'dra'i rwa ba gru bzhi sum rim steng*// gcig thog gcig brtsegs ri bo tsam du mtho// de nang zla ba 'og dang nyi ma steng*// nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar zhing tsha ba des// sus kyang blta bar mi bzod mig tshig pa// de nang nyi ma g.yas dang zla ba g.yon// gwa'u kha sbyor kha 'grigs gyen du langs// de nang nyi ma 'og dang zla ba steng*// gwa'u kha sbyor yangs shing rgya che ba// de dbus rang nyid lha mo'i skur gsal ba'i// g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab bsrung bya mi nor tshud// nyi zla sum rims shin tu 'od che bas// gnod byed kun gyi mig bsgribs bltar mi zug

/bsrung bya thams cad de nang gab pa las// rang nyid lha mo'i thugs rjes bskyabs par bsgom// oṃ mā rī tsyai 'od zer can bdag cag dpon slob mi nor thams cad la skyobs shig swā hā/ de ni snga dro'i srung ba'i dmigs pa yin// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer las// sprul pa'i lha mo bye ba dung phyur tshogs// kun kyang phag rgod ser po 'brong g.yag tsam// rlung ltar phyogs bcur rgyugs pa chibs su bcibs// rdo rje pha lam rgyu las grub pa yi// rnon po khab dang skud pa mnyen mo thogs// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra jag chom rkun gyi// mig rnams btsems pas gnod pa'i nus pa bral// de ltar bsgom zhing sngags ring 'di nyid bzla// oṃ mā rī tsyai battā li/ ba dā li/ bā rā ha mu khi/ sarba duṣṭān pra duṣṭān

gnod byed dgra jag chom rkun gcan gzan rnams che ge mo skabs su gang bab sbyar/ tsakṣurmu khaṃ bhandha bhandha swā hā/ de yis jag rkun 'ching ba'i mchog tu 'gyur// mi kha bsrung ba'i thabs kyang de zab bo// sgrub pa byed na byed lugs de ltar te// sngon du sgrub pa grub bam ma grub kyang*// gzhung ltar mngon rtogs bsgom par byas nas kyang*// sngags tshan gsum po rim bzhin ci nus bzla// 'jigs skrag med cing bde ba'i skabs su ni// bsnyen pa'i sngags dang dmigs pa ci nus bya// 'jigs skrag dogs pa yod na bar ma med// rkun dogs la sogs shin tu skrag pa'i dus// sngags ring de nyid ci nus mang bar bzla// de ni dril sgrub rgyun khyer zhes bya yin// gal te bsnyen sgrub la sogs long med par// dgra dang rgyal po'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa// 'phral du nyen 'byung ci bya rtol med na// mtshams sdom grub na legs shing ma grub kyang*// dmigs pa gsal bas sngags tshan gsum po rnams// stong phrag re'am yang na brgya phrag re// bzlas rjes slar yang mngon rtogs zhig re 'don// de ltar rtse gcig ma yengs 'bad pa na// rnam smin mthong chos myong 'gyur ma gtogs pa'i// 'jigs pa gang yang mi skyob srid mi 'gyur// bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas gsungs pa yi// 'od zer can gyi gzungs dang rtog pa ni// bya ba'i rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs na yang*// rdo rje gur sogs gsar ma'i bla med rgyud// lha mo dngos grub brtan gzigs la sogs pa// rnying ma'i rgyud sde rnams nas mang du gsungs// rdor phreng nang du dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yod// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho brgya rtsa gnyis ka nang*// zhal phyag mang po'i rigs kyang mang du yod// gnam chos dgongs gter gnyis nas byung ba dang*// gsar rnying rgyud gzhung kun gyi don bsdus te// rgyun khyer nyams len tshig nyung don zab yin// 'di nyid nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon kyang*// nad rnams thams cad med par 'gyur ba dang*// rims rnams thams cad med par 'gyur ba dang*// dgra dang rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs pas// btson du bzung dang bkyigs dang lcags su bcug

/chad pas bcad dang mgo bo breg pa dang*// me la bsreg dang chu ru bskyur ba dang*// dug dang mtshon gyis gsod par byed pa sogs// dgra yi gnod pa gang yang 'byung mi 'gyur// jag rkun gcan gzan thams cad bcing ba'i mchog /nor dang longs spyod la sogs 'phel ba dang*// nges par mchog gi dngos grub thob par gsungs// mnan pa sbyin sreg la sogs ma gsungs kyang*// nye bar mkho ba'i las tshogs gcig brjod pa// bal gtsang srung skud dkar po ring ba la// rang nyid lha mo'i bskyed rim bsgoms byas la// mig btsums kha dang lce sogs dam du bsdams// sngags ring de nyid yid kyis bzlas byas shing*// srung skud mdud pa nyer gcig ma tshar bar// mig gis mi lta dbugs kyang phyir mi gtong*// mdud pa re la lha mo re re bsgom// tshar nas phu bya sngags ring mang du bsngags// rta drel la sogs gang la btags pa de// jag rkun srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur bar gsungs// de bzhin shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pa'i sar// phag gi rwa ba sum rim sogs bsgom zhing*// sngags ring de nyid rtse gcig bzla bzhin du// lag pa gnyis po thal mo sbyar byas te// kha phye mtheb chen gnyis po cung zad bkug /gung mo gnyis po rtse mo phan tshun reg /sdigs mdzub gnyis po gung mo la sbyar te// zlum pa'i rnam par byas pa'i phyag rgya de// rang nyid skyil krung gnas pa'i lte bar gtugs// de nas sngags ring dmigs pa dang bcas pas// dgra yi nang du song kyang mi mthong zhing*// gal te mthong yang gnod par mi 'gyur gsungs// rang gi srung ba sngags dang phyag rgya ste// gzhan gyi srung ba srung skud de yin no// 'di las zab pa'i dgra chings rkun chings ni// thub pa'i zhal nas gsung ba med nges so// zhes so// zhes pa 'di'ang bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi bka' lung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pa ltar/ zhu chen rin po che'i sgrol dkar bsnyen yig kha bsgyur dang*/
